rows.text: zeroes the twenty qwords `rcx+0x00` through `rcx+0x98`, then calls the import through `008C31A0`; when that returns non-zero it tail-jumps `001F3AE0(rcx)`, otherwise it returns that zero

returns at once unless the sign-extended dword `[rcx]` equals qword `[rdx]`; otherwise increments dword `rcx+0x14` and, when it then equals dword `rcx+0x10` minus 1, takes the `+0x28` interface of `008C3190(01DFE0D0)` and calls its vtable slot `+0x30` with qword `[[rcx+8]+8]` and `[rcx+8]+0x190`, then calls `0020CE10(rcx, qword [[rcx+8]+8])` when byte `[[rcx+8]+0x190]` is zero; on both count paths it ends with a tail jump to `005CDAA0(2, 00906490)`

returns at once unless the sign-extended dword `[rcx]` equals qword `[rdx]`; otherwise tail-jumps `005CDAA0(2, 00906458, dword [rdx+8])` when dword `[rdx+8]` is 1 and `005CDAA0(2, 00906470, dword [rdx+8])` for any other value

re-fetches `008C3190(01DFE0D0)` before each step and returns 0 in `al` when its qword `+0x28` is null, when its qword `+8` is null, or when vtable slot `+8` of the `+8` interface returns zero in `al`; otherwise tail-jumps vtable slot `+0` of the `+0x28` interface with that interface as `rcx`

does nothing when qword `01F83450` is non-null; otherwise calls `00210EC0(0x80)` and, when that is non-null, `0020C730(it, 01DFE410, 0x29)`, then stores `0020C730`'s return value (or the null `00210EC0` result) to `01F83450`

returns 0 in `al` when byte `rcx+0x18` is zero; otherwise calls vtable slot `+0x38` of the `+0x28` interface of `008C3190(01DFE0D0)` with `rdx`, re-fetches that interface and tail-jumps its vtable slot `+0x50`

notes: 001F3E10 and 0020C8C0: the imports behind 008C31A0 and 008C3190 are not named in the listing, so the rows name only the IAT slots. 0020CD30: the stored value is rax after 0020C730 returns, so it is that callee's return value (the page may read it as the new object); FABLE should confirm 0020C730 returns rcx.
